description: This file implements classes and functions for managing WebRTC server connections over Unix sockets and WebSocket protocols, including connection handling, message sending, and WebSocket event callbacks.

classes.name: UnixServerConnection
classes.description: Manages a server connection over a Unix domain socket, including connection establishment, message sending, and background thread for reading data.

classes.name: WsConnection
classes.description: Handles WebSocket connection lifecycle, message sending, and event callbacks for WebRTC over websockets.

classes.name: WsConnectionContext
classes.description: Creates and manages WebSocket connections, maintains connection mappings, and runs the WebSocket event loop.

classes.name: WsBuffer
classes.description: Represents a buffer for WebSocket message data, including binary and text data.

classes.name: WsConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class to adapt WsConnection to the ServerConnection interface for use in the connection factory.

methods.name: UnixServerConnection::Send
methods.description: Serializes a JSON message and sends it over the Unix socket.

methods.name: UnixServerConnection::Connect
methods.description: Establishes a Unix socket connection and starts the background read thread.

methods.name: UnixServerConnection::ReadLoop
methods.description: Background thread function that waits for socket events and reads incoming data.

methods.name: WsConnection::ConnectInner
methods.description: Performs the WebSocket client connection using libwebsockets.

methods.name: WsConnection::OnWriteable
methods.description: Handles the event when the WebSocket is ready to send more data.

methods.name: WsConnection::Send
methods.description: Serializes a JSON message and queues it for sending over WebSocket.

methods.name: WsConnection::Send (binary data)
methods.description: Queues binary or text data for WebSocket transmission.

methods.name: WsConnectionContext::Create
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocket context with libwebsockets.

methods.name: WsConnectionContext::RememberConnection
methods.description: Stores a weak reference to a WebSocket connection.

methods.name: WsConnectionContext::GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a shared pointer to a WebSocket connection from a raw pointer.
